import { Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Input, Output, ViewChild, AfterViewInit, OnChanges, SimpleChanges } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { AppIconComponent } from '../icons/app-icon.component'; import { trigger, transition, style, animate } from '@angular/animations'; @Component({ selector: 'app-rich-text-editor', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, AppIconComponent], template: `
{{ replyTo.sender }} {{ replyTo.timestamp }}
{{ size }}px
{{ placeholder }}
`, styles: [` .rich-text-content { word-break: break-word; overflow-wrap: anywhere; line-height: 1.15; font-size: 14px; } `], animations: [ trigger('toolbarAnimation', [ transition(':enter', [ style({ opacity: 0, height: 0, transform: 'translateY(-10px)' }), animate('250ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1)', style({ opacity: 1, height: '*', transform: 'translateY(0)' }) ) ]), transition(':leave', [ animate('200ms ease-in', style({ opacity: 0, height: 0, transform: 'translateY(-5px)' }) ) ]) ]) ] }) export class RichTextEditorComponent implements AfterViewInit, OnChanges { @Input() placeholder: string = 'Type your message...'; @Input() content: string = ''; @Input() showToolbar: boolean = false; @Input() maxHeight: string = '200px'; @Input() replyTo: any = null; @Output() contentChange = new EventEmitter(); @Output() enterPressed = new EventEmitter(); @Output() cancelReply = new EventEmitter(); isPreviewExpanded = false; @ViewChild('editor') editorRef!: ElementRef; fontSize = '14'; currentColor = '#262626'; colors = [ '#262626', // Black '#007A91', // CommSuite Blue '#D32F2F', // Red '#388E3C', // Green '#F57C00', // Orange '#7B1FA2', // Purple '#000000', // Pure Black '#1976D2' // Deep Blue ]; isBold = false; isItalic = false; isUnderline = false; isStrikethrough = false; isFocused = false; isEmpty: boolean = true; get placeholderTop(): string { if (this.replyTo) { // Dynamic calculation based on expanded state const toolbarHeight = this.showToolbar ? 52 : 0; const replyBaseHeight = 80; // Base height for collapsed reply const expandedExtraHeight = this.isPreviewExpanded ? 100 : 0; // Extra when expanded return (toolbarHeight + replyBaseHeight + expandedExtraHeight + 10) + 'px'; } return this.showToolbar ? '52px' : '10px'; } shouldShowReadMore(content: string | undefined): boolean { if (!content) return false; return content.length > 150 || content.includes('
') || content.includes(''); } private updateIsEmpty() { if (!this.editorRef) { this.isEmpty = !this.content; return; } const html = this.editorRef.nativeElement.innerHTML || ''; const text = this.editorRef.nativeElement.innerText || ''; // Robust check for empty content this.isEmpty = !html || html === '
' || html === '

' || text.trim() === ''; } ngAfterViewInit() { if (this.content && this.editorRef) { this.editorRef.nativeElement.innerHTML = this.content; } this.updateIsEmpty(); } ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges) { if (changes['content']) { if (this.editorRef && this.content !== this.editorRef.nativeElement.innerHTML) { this.editorRef.nativeElement.innerHTML = this.content || ''; this.checkActiveStyles(); this.updateIsEmpty(); } else if (!this.editorRef) { this.isEmpty = !this.content; } } } onInput() { if (this.editorRef) { this.contentChange.emit(this.editorRef.nativeElement.innerHTML); this.checkActiveStyles(); this.updateIsEmpty(); } } onFocus() { this.isFocused = true; this.showToolbar = true; this.checkActiveStyles(); } onBlur() { setTimeout(() => { this.isFocused = false; }, 200); } onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) { if (event.key === 'Enter' && !event.shiftKey) { event.preventDefault(); this.enterPressed.emit(); } } execCommand(command: string, value: string | any = null) { document.execCommand(command, false, value); this.checkActiveStyles(); this.onInput(); } setFontSize(size: string) { this.fontSize = size; this.execCommand('fontSize', '7'); // Use a placeholder size const fontTags = this.editorRef.nativeElement.getElementsByTagName('font'); for (let i = 0; i < fontTags.length; i++) { if (fontTags[i].size === '7') { fontTags[i].removeAttribute('size'); fontTags[i].style.fontSize = size + 'px'; fontTags[i].style.lineHeight = (parseInt(size) + 2) + 'px'; // Maintain proportions } } } setTextColor(color: string) { this.currentColor = color; this.execCommand('foreColor', color); } checkActiveStyles() { this.isBold = document.queryCommandState('bold'); this.isItalic = document.queryCommandState('italic'); this.isUnderline = document.queryCommandState('underline'); } public clear() { if (this.editorRef) { this.editorRef.nativeElement.innerHTML = ''; this.onInput(); } } public focus() { this.editorRef?.nativeElement?.focus(); } }
